user.title: Login method
user.description: Choose the same login method you use in the official Deepal app. Email-code login is recommended where phone/SMS login does not find the account.

email.title: Email login
email.description: Enter the email address used by the official Deepal app. Changan/Deepal will send a one-time verification code to this address.

email_code.title: Enter email code
email_code.description: Enter the verification code sent by Changan/Deepal. The code can expire quickly, so request a new one if it is rejected.

data_description.start_over: Go back and request a new email code. You can leave the code blank.

phone.title: Phone/SMS login
phone.description: Log in with the same phone number you use in the Deepal app. Choose your country/region, then enter the local number exactly as registered in the official app, without the international prefix.

sms.title: Enter SMS code
sms.description: Enter the verification code sent by Changan/Deepal. The code can expire quickly, so request a new one if it is rejected. If no SMS arrives, cancel and start again with email login.

data_description.start_over: Go back and request a new SMS code. You can leave the code blank.

commands.title: Remote commands
commands.description: Remote commands let Home Assistant control things like climate, charging, locks, and windows. Leave them disabled if you only want read-only vehicle data. The control PIN is the same PIN used for remote controls in the Deepal app.

error.send_code_failed: Could not request an SMS code. Check the phone number and country/region.
error.send_email_code_failed: Could not request an email code. Check the email address and country/region.
error.account_not_registered: Deepal says this account is not registered for the selected country/region. Choose the region used by the official app account, or try the other login method.
error.login_failed: Login failed. Check the verification code and account details.
error.bad_sms_code: The SMS code was rejected or expired. Request a new code and try again.
error.bad_email_code: The email code was rejected or expired. Request a new code and try again.
error.too_many_codes: Too many verification attempts. Wait a while before requesting another code.
error.no_vehicles: Login succeeded, but no vehicles were returned.
error.wrong_account: Login succeeded, but this account did not return the vehicle already configured in Home Assistant.
error.pin_required: Enter your control PIN, or leave remote commands disabled.

abort.reauth_successful: Deepal is connected again. Home Assistant will resume refreshing your vehicle data.

init.title: Changan Deepal Cloud options
init.description: Tune how often Home Assistant reads cached cloud data and how often it asks the vehicle for fresh data. Remote commands require the control PIN from the Deepal app. To allow vehicle location, paste the QR URL from the head unit's Privacy → Location permission screen. That URL is used once and is not saved.

data.enable_live_mqtt: Keep a live MQTT connection (S05 only)

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the cached cloud status. This is lightweight and does not wake or actively query the car.
data_description.active_refresh_interval: How often Home Assistant sends the signed refresh command that asks the cloud/car for newer vehicle data. Only used when remote commands are enabled.
data_description.control_pin: The same PIN used for remote controls in the official Deepal app. Required when remote commands are enabled.
data_description.enable_commands: Allow Home Assistant to send signed commands such as refresh, lock, climate, charging, windows, boot, seat and steering wheel heating, lights, and horn. MQTT vehicles (e.g. S05) support lock, windows and boot only.
data_description.enable_api_logging: Write redacted Deepal API requests and responses to the Home Assistant log for troubleshooting. Tokens, PINs, signatures, keys, and account identifiers are filtered, but vehicle data may still appear. Leave disabled unless debugging.
data_description.enable_live_mqtt: Experimental. Keeps one MQTT connection open to push telemetry updates between the normal polls, instead of waiting for the next one. Only has an effect on an S05 reporting protocol MQTT (not the E07's SDA-MQTT, which this is not known to work with yet). The regular poll keeps running underneath this either way, so turning this off (or a connection failure) never makes data go stale beyond the usual poll interval. Untested on a real S05.
data_description.low_tyre_pressure_kpa: Warn when any tyre is below this pressure (used by the Low tyre pressure sensor). Default 230 kPa; lower or raise it to match this car's own placard minimum.
data_description.qr_auth_url: Paste the QR link from the car head unit (Privacy → Location permission), or the bare qrCode token. Leave blank to skip. This is not stored.
data_description.reauthenticate: Logs in again to get a fresh command-signing key, without deleting or re-adding the integration. Use this if remote commands (lock, windows, boot, climate, charging, lights, horn) fail outright while vehicle data still updates normally. Any other changes made in this same submission are ignored - reopen this dialog afterward for those.

error.qr_auth_failed: Could not authorise that QR code. Open the location permission screen on the car again and paste the new URL.

abort.reauth_triggered: Starting reauthentication. Home Assistant will show a notification to finish logging in again - complete that to register the fresh command-signing key.

confirm.title: [%key:component::deepal::issues::command_reauth::title%]
confirm.description: This logs in again to register a fresh command-signing key. Home Assistant will show a notification to finish logging in again once you confirm.

error.qr_auth_failed: Could not authorise that QR code. Open the location permission screen on the car again and paste the new URL.

authorize.title: Authorise Deepal location permission
authorize.description: Paste the QR URL shown on the car head unit under Privacy → Location permission. The code changes each time that screen is opened. Home Assistant sends it to your Deepal account; no control PIN is required.
